scope: Yield Basis LT deposit integration plus retained withdrawal; authorized generic executor-program transport and cache-first validation are separate commits
supersedesPriorFinding: The deposit integration and complete-executor-program validation gap now has the following current-source historical evidence. Prior performance and original-opportunity limits remain.

implementation.protocolMeaning: The protocol AMM supplies the stablecoin leg. The caller supplies only the asset. Debt is derived with checked uint256 arithmetic from current bound pool reserves inside the executor program.
implementation.exact: One guarded complete-program simulation for nonzero deposit amounts, without an off-chain reserve dependency round, linear NAV quote, preview fallback or arbitrary preCalls.
implementation.rawMid: Deposit NAV normalized from pricePerShare; it is not used as an amount-sensitive Exact output.
implementation.execution: Quoted and runtime paths share the guarded production emitter: reset/exact approval/cleanup, exact asset debit, returned shares equal actual receipt, minimum shares and stable/native inventory conservation.
implementation.identity: Fits four production rounds. Raw deposit success is insufficient: the complete guarded executor program must pass. Deterministic deposit failure preserves an independently verified withdrawal direction; transport failures are not permanent semantic rejection.
implementation.genericCacheBehavior: Only isolated counterfactual executor self-programs first try the production interpreter on a cloned request overlay backed by canonical pinned cached state. Missing state is an error, not invented zero. A miss leaves the original overlay unchanged and uses code-aware trace hints followed by canonical hash-pinned hydration. Hint values are never shared-state authority. Source checks and effect checks remain mandatory. Other top-level and prefix modes are unchanged.

sourceBindings.scopeNote: The TypeScript tree fingerprint includes contemporaneous peer source changes, which are preserved but not part of this commit. Rust, harness, executor and immutable input fingerprints are bound separately. The Linux binary is validation-only, not a deployment replacement.
